name: Aquarium Co-Op Easy Green
description: Popular beginner-friendly all-in-one liquid. The manufacturer publishes a guaranteed-analysis nitrogen figure but not a full per-dose ppm breakdown across all axes, so values are NOT disclosed here — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: 1 pump per 10 US gal is the label dose. Proprietary blend — per-dose ppm not fully published, so dosing effect is modelled by an all-in-one category default downstream.
